question: Select the most appropriate option for blank (4)
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**gathered**" means to collect or bring together. (इकट्ठा करना)
 
• In the context of the passage, **"gathered data on 187 non-native species and 1,852 native species" **means the scientists collected information on these species.
 
• The other options: "**mingled**," "**cooperated**," and "**separated**" do not convey the correct meaning of collecting data.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *To better understand how native and non-native species respond to extreme weather events, the scientists behind the new study reanalysed information from 443 peer-reviewed studies on how species responded to wildfires, droughts and storms. In all, they gathered__ data on 187 non-native species and 1,852 native species from all major animal groups.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Mingled (मिलना-जुलना)**: means to mix or cause to mix together.
 
• **Cooperated (सहयोग करना)**: means to work together towards a common goal.
 
• **Separated (अलग करना)**: means to divide or cause to divide into different groups or categories.
